arguments.assumptions: Explicit hypothetical FY2027 US-GAAP diluted EPS and P/E sensitivity, not consensus, a target, or an observed multiple. FY2027 is a 53-week year; $4.85 six-month GAAP diluted EPS is the reported anchor. Bear/base/bull annual EPS of $8.00/$10.00/$12.00 imply residual second-half EPS of $3.15/$5.15/$7.15 under a constant-share approximation. Q3 revenue guidance is $108bn +/-2%, 74% GAAP gross-margin guidance, approximately $9.2bn GAAP opex and 16%-18% FY tax-rate outlook; no Q4 guidance or forward diluted-share count is supplied. P/E stress assumptions 20x/24x/28x test earnings execution and multiple compression/expansion without empirical probability, fair-value claim, or historical-multiple claim.

cases.rationale: Hypothesis: Q3 lands toward/below guided revenue range and the 14-week Q4 does not sustain the Q2-to-Q3 demand ramp; use a lower residual EPS than the base, paired with a compression stress.

Hypothesis: reported first-half EPS plus a positive second half consistent with Q3 revenue/margin/opex/tax outlook and continued data-center demand, without assuming China compute revenue; multiple held as an explicit stress assumption.
Hypothesis: Q3 execution and a longer fourth quarter preserve demand and margin momentum, producing residual EPS above base; paired with an expansion stress.
